description: Mechanistic groupings of biological pathways. Each pathway declares exactly one mechanismCategory. Categories drive (a) interaction templates, (b) reversibility defaults, (c) recovery-modifier vector seed, and (d) doctor-view grouping in narrative projections.

categories.label: Follicular Cycle Mechanisms
categories.description: Pathways acting directly on anagen/catagen/telogen kinetics and follicle architecture (size, anchorage). Drives miniaturization vs. shedding differentiation.

categories.label: Inflammatory Mechanisms
categories.description: Perifollicular and scalp-surface inflammation, cytokine-driven processes, microbiome-mediated disruption.

categories.label: Endocrine Mechanisms
categories.description: Androgen, thyroid, estrogen, and reproductive-transition perturbations affecting follicle behavior.

categories.label: Immune-Targeting Mechanisms
categories.description: Autoimmune or T-cell-mediated follicular targeting (areata spectrum, scarring forms).

categories.label: Metabolic Mechanisms
categories.description: Insulin-glucose axis, adiposity-hormonal cross-talk, substrate-energy disruption.

categories.label: Gut–Hair Axis Mechanisms
categories.description: Absorption, microbiome, mucosal-inflammation contributions to systemic substrate availability.

categories.label: Nutritional / Substrate Mechanisms
categories.description: Micronutrient and macronutrient substrate insufficiency affecting follicle proliferation.

categories.label: Structural / Extrinsic Mechanisms
categories.description: Cortical/cuticle compromise from extrinsic exposures and mechanical insults. Shaft-level, not follicular-level.

interactionTemplates.description: Activation of A elevates downstream consequence of B by interactionAmplificationCap (see confidence-model.json).
A is required pathway-intermediate for B's worst-case consequence.
A and B explain mutually exclusive observations of the same signal class.
